services.name: Sunset Cruise Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a private dolphin and wildlife cruise through the scenic waters of the Outer Banks. The Daytime Cruise with Old Man Charters is perfect for guests who want to slow down, take in the views, and experience dolphins, coastal wildlife, and local waterways at a relaxed, comfortable pace. Unlike typical dolphin tours that simply head out and return to the dock, our private cruises allow time to linger with dolphins, explore wildlife-rich areas, and enjoy optional activities like swimming, sand island exploration, or simply cruising and relaxing on the water. Private cruises customized around what matters most to you - dolphins, scenery, stories, or simply unwinding. Encounter ospreys,

includes: Personalized cruises shaped by your group’s pace
Expert local guides who are lifelong Outer Banks locals

blurb: Guests join private or public boat tours departing from a private dock in Wanchese, NC. Tours include dolphin sightings, wildlife encounters, and scenic views of the Outer Banks marshes and sounds. Options include daytime and sunset cruises, with opportunities for swim stops and photo opportunities.
